value.rationale: Cut-locus clearance measures the intrinsic size of the unique-geodesic region as seen by uniform sampling. For the entire two-torus moduli family its exact two-phase distribution detects lattice well-roundedness from an endpoint exponent and provides an exact strict distributional optimizer of fixed area. It is more informative than a routine evaluation for a single symmetry case, and the one-dimensional chamber calculation plus geometric stochastic comparison make a motivated complete classification. We do not claim the generic tube theorem or isoperimetric inequality as new.
